paper.title: Fortran code for automatic differentiation (ADM: symbolic and generated derivatives, Dobmann, Liepelt and Schittkowski)
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 21(3), Sep 1995, p. 233; collected as TOMS Algorithm 746
paper.url: https://netlib.org/toms/746.gz (ACM article not read; ACM pages are not fetched here)

code.commit: netlib TOMS archive 746.gz, sha256 c68a4dffe06114a5d59f4feff663a734adcaa930d6513d88c3efae22188b5749 (fetched by scout 2026-11-27 into a fresh /tmp dir; read as text, not executed).
code.note: Shell archive. Member Fortran77/Dp/Drivers/Results/tp1.res is shipped; its generating recipe is the Makefile target tp1 (cp Examples/tp1.inp ADM.INP; cp Examples/tp1.fun ADM.FUN; admfor; compile adm.o adm_gen.f src.o; run adm; cp ADM.RES Results/tp1.res). Inputs Examples/tp1.inp and tp1.fun are shipped and read by scout.

claim.location: Shipped reference output Fortran77/Dp/Drivers/Results/tp1.res inside 746.gz. Claim row: 'Generated derivative error' for TP1 (Rosenbrock, F=100*(X2-X1**2)**2+(1-X1)**2) at X=(-2.0, 1.0), MAXFUN=10000 function repeats, printed 0.451D-03. The symbolic-derivative error line in the same file prints the same 0.451D-03.

reference.sha256: not the member's own hash: scout's extracted text of the member has sha256 3d7dbfd658cf74b50b02c7def6469a52b41b58727d55811936779087b60bf73e (line-split from the shar; rerun should compare the member, not this)

claim.metric: Generated derivative error, as printed by the driver (D format, three significant digits), for TP1 at the starting point given in tp1.inp.
claim.paper_value: The ACM article is not read here. The value is the shipped reference output Results/tp1.res; the function value 909 at that point is printed alongside and is a check that the test ran, not the claim.

tolerance.basis: The printed value has three significant digits, so its rounding half-unit is 5e-6 on 0.451e-3. Tolerance is set to that half-unit, before any run, and is not to be loosened after a run. A different derivative code path moves this error by much more than rounding would.

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 1 minute for TP1 at 10000 repeats; the build needs a Fortran compiler and the admfor generator.
cost.data_size: None; the function is in tp1.fun.
cost.data_licence: No data. Source is the public netlib TOMS archive.

why: The driver generates Fortran derivative code and times the run, so the printed derivative error is an output of the method and not a closed form; the function value 909 alone would be derivable by hand, which is why the claim is the derivative error.
